name: He Follows
source:
Every night, he would come up to talk to me after class. At first it was weird how he would chat and only compliment me. I wasn't sure if it was his lack of confidence or maybe that I was just overthinking it.

But then one night, he wasn't waiting at his usual spot.

[From [url=https://lyrvx.itch.io/he-follows]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
每天晚上下课后他都会过来找我聊天。起初，我很奇怪他聊天时只夸奖我。我不确定是他缺乏自信还是我想太多了。

但有一天晚上，他没有在原来的位置等候。
